title: Liquid Fusion
description:
Drip, Drip, Drip into a pool of liquid and become ONE with your Goddess

As you are guided in a hypnotic trance, you are transported into another dimension. In this new realm, an Amethyst rain pours down on you. The wetter you become, the more you begin to melt into droplets of liquid.

Dripping, dripping, dripping into a pool of Amethyst liquid.  Your Goddess also transforms into liquid and merges with you as a cohesive pool of sensual bliss. A lovers dance of bodiless union vibrates, pulses, and brings you to ecstasy.

Features: 10-1 Countdown, double voice, sound effects of rain, thunder, dripping

I prefer that you purchase from DeepSurrender, but this title is also available on NiteFlirt
